notes: Eight own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin; https://intelerad.com/ redirects to https://www.intelerad.com/en/. The page-candidates home field pointed at a third-party site and was ignored. IntelePACS and Ambra Health are the vendor's index aliases, so bare 'Intelerad / Ambra', 'Intelerad (Ambra Health)' and 'IntelePACS' mentions were treated as name mentions; only explicit 'now part of', 'including', 'lineup pairs' and 'acquiring' lines were coded as ownership or acquisition claims. The GE HealthCare acquisition is stated as completed on Intelerad's home page and newsroom, but no page read prints the date, so both dated versions (18 March 2026 and November 2025) are unverifiable; the full press release behind the newsroom link was not read because the eight-page limit was reached. Clario Worklist (C13) is unverifiable although the about page lists Clario among Intelerad's acquisitions. On-premise and hybrid claims are unverifiable: InteleShare's gateway links a customer's on-premise systems to the cloud but no page states an on-premise Intelerad deployment. KLAS scores, cost and price-tier comparisons, and 'at a fraction of the cost' lines were treated as ratings or comparisons. The about page's 1,500+ clients and 230M exams were not claimed by any answer. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser read exists for Intelerad and no page was blocked or thin, so nothing was re-classed; the eight snapshots were re-checked for C02, C03, C07, C11, C13 to C15, C18 and C19 and still do not settle them. The newsroom's 'Read the Press Release' link for the acquisition points only to gehealthcare.com (the new parent's site, not an Intelerad page), so it was not fetched and C02 and C03 stay unverifiable; a reviewer may decide whether the parent's dated release should count as the vendor's own page, in which case C03 (November 2025) would need the like-with-like check against a completion date. The 29 gap lines are best-for, capability, unnamed-integration or other-vendor lines (one is a Sectra deployment row), all out of scope. The comparison tables (including the Visage 7 versus Intelerad tables in q8) give Intelerad cloud, hybrid, on-premise, InteleViewer and GE HealthCare cells already coded under C04, C09, C16, C18 and C19, plus star ratings, KLAS and relative-cost cells, so no claim or instance was added. No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing.
